title: Bear and Blocks
statementMd:
Limak is a little bear who loves to play. Today he is playing by destroying block towers. He built $*n*$ towers in a row. The $*i*$-th tower is made of $*h*_{*i*}$ identical blocks. For clarification see picture for the first sample.

Limak will repeat the following operation till everything is destroyed.

Block is called internal if it has all four neighbors, i.e. it has each side (top, left, down and right) adjacent to other block or to the floor. Otherwise, block is boundary. In one operation Limak destroys all boundary blocks. His paws are very fast and he destroys all those blocks at the same time.

Limak is ready to start. You task is to count how many operations will it take him to destroy all towers.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ — sizes of towers.

## Output

Print the number of operations needed to destroy all towers.

## Note

The picture below shows all three operations for the first sample test. Each time boundary blocks are marked with red color.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03536e679d62748811026b5575567b66ad9c43b2.png)

After first operation there are four blocks left and only one remains after second operation. This last block is destroyed in third operation.
statementZhMd:
Limak 是一只喜欢玩耍的小熊。今天，他正在通过摧毁方块塔来玩耍。他将 $*n*$ 座方块塔排成一排。第 $*i*$ 座塔由 $*h*_{*i*}$ 个相同的方块组成。第一组样例的示意图如下。

Limak 会不断重复以下操作，直到所有方块都被摧毁。

如果一个方块的四个方向都有邻居，即它的每一面（上、左、下、右）都与另一个方块或地面相邻，则称该方块为内部方块。否则，该方块为边界方块。在一次操作中，Limak 会摧毁所有边界方块。他的爪子非常快，可以同时摧毁所有这些方块。

Limak 已经准备开始了。你的任务是计算他需要进行多少次操作才能摧毁所有方块塔。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*h*_{1}, *h*_{2}, ..., *h*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *h*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示各座方块塔的高度。

## 输出格式

输出摧毁所有方块塔所需的操作次数。

## 说明

下图展示了第一组样例测试中的全部三次操作。每次操作中，边界方块都用红色标记。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/03536e679d62748811026b5575567b66ad9c43b2.png)

第一次操作后还剩四个方块，第二次操作后只剩一个方块。这个最后剩下的方块会在第三次操作中被摧毁。
